name: a11y-forms-error-messaging-audit
description: Audits every form field and every error state for labels and instructions (1.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2), input purpose `autocomplete` tokens (1.3.5), error identification and suggestion (3.3.1, 3.3.3), error prevention for legal and financial data (3.3.4), redundant entry (3.3.7), accessible authentication (3.3.8) and announced status messages (4.1.3).
